premises: Account01/B05 conditional definite 2x2 physical principal-block theorem at math-open-problems@8b471bfd0ff8df0ce71ed0fcf49bcbd94531b1b5.
mathematical_summary: For the exact three-bank selected frame r_j=m^{-1/2}1_{G_j} with C=I-RR^T and A=I-2r_3r_3^T, selected row leverage is 1/m ->0, yet after every physical conditioning H with eta<1 every physical block partition of whitened mass mu<1/3 and every block-diagonal approximant C0 obeys ||C[T,T]-C0|| >= (1-eta)sqrt(2)/3. Therefore the prior B08 approximate-block stability hypothesis cannot be extracted from selected-frame delocalization alone. The same target-valid family is uniformly safe by a definite original-coordinate principal I_2, giving density <=pi. The latest account03/B08 theorem applied to m=16 and complementary eigenvalue epsilon=1/64 gives density <48.
next_step: Prove a quantitative product-preserving dichotomy after bounded selected-mass conditioning: either the remainder admits a B08 approximate-block certificate, or a uniformly nondegenerate physical smoothing object (definite principal pair, dependence-safe bank, or ridge certificate) pays the full conditional quadratic form.
